name.text: Interpret the text and use the information to calculate conditional probabilities

questiontext.text:
Of all the households in Kisumu County, {@prob_plasma@}% have a plasma TV and {@prob_laptop@}% have a Laptop computer. There are {@prob_both@}% of households that have both a plasma TV and a Laptop. Find the probability that a household chosen at random has either a plasma TV or a Laptop computer but not both. Give your answer in percentage.

[[input:ans1]]% [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
To find the probability that a household chosen at random has either a plasma TV or a Laptop computer but not both. We need to find first the probability a household has only a laptop computer i.e P(plasmaTv)-P(both plasmaTV and laptop computer) then find the probability a household has only a plasma TV i.e P(Laptop computer)-P(both plasmaTV and laptop computer) and get the sum.

\( P (\text{Plasma TV or Laptop but not both}) = (P(\text{Plasma TV}) - P(\text{Both})) + (P(\text{Laptop computer}) - P(\text{Both}))\)

\(= ({@prob_plasma@}-{@prob_both@})+({@prob_laptop@}-{@prob_both@})\)

= \({@prob_plasma-prob_both@}+ {@prob_laptop-prob_both@}\)

= {@ta1@}%
